sanskrit_verse:
एककाले समानीते प्रत्यर्थी सभ्यसंनिधौ ।
पूर्वपक्षाक्षरसमं लेखयेद् उत्तरं ततः ॥
transliteration: ekakāle samānīte pratyarthī sabhyasaṃnidhau | pūrvapakṣākṣarasamaṃ lekhayed uttaraṃ tataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When both parties appear simultaneously before the assembly, the respondent shall first present their reply in writing equal in length to the plaintiff's initial assertion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the immediacy of presence within the sabhā (judicial assembly)
Causation arises through balanced textual response ensuring parity of expression
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by the ability to articulate a counter-assertion commensurate with the original claim
Restoration logic requires equilibrium between disputing voices prior to resolution
Consciousness alignment occurs when each party reflects upon and responds to the precise energetic imprint of the other
executable_legal_axioms: IF two parties are present in sabhā at the same time THEN the respondent MUST submit a written reply EQUAL IN LENGTH to the plaintiff’s initial statement
IF either party fails to meet textual parity THEN the case SHALL NOT proceed until balance is restored
IF imbalance persists beyond three cycles of restorative prompting THEN automatic suspension of hearing for capacity recalibration
ALL responses MUST be evaluated for akṣara-level correspondence to ensure energetic symmetry
supreme_court_application: In the Supreme Court of Dharma, when litigants arrive concurrently and are equally present before the judicial body, procedural law demands that the respondent provide a rebuttal of exact textual proportion. This ensures no voice dominates merely due to primacy of speech, restoring parity as foundational to just adjudication.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa manifests through the measurable equivalence of akṣaras, establishing objective causality via linguistic symmetry. Anupūrvaśaḥ unfolds as sequential reflection — first the charge, then the counter — enabling proportional clarity without punitive judgment. Responsibility aligns with expressive capacity; imbalance indicates misalignment rather than fault. Non-punitivity is upheld by focusing on completion and recalibration, not blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Party failing to match akṣara count receives guided drafting support until parity is achieved
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Each speaker signs off on the energetic resonance of their words before proceeding
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: If repeated imbalances occur, speaker undergoes pramāṇa-based communication realignment
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Post-reply, both parties recite each other's statements aloud to confirm mutual recognition
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ordinance stands executed. Justice flows from consciousness alignment, not coercion. The act of equitable reply restores harmony. Reality acknowledges only truth-speaking. Punishment has no place here. SPH is the Law.
